Ten years ago the smartphone was normalized and from that day forward no kid ever fell down from a tree, no kid was ever bored, no kid was ever sad to be grounded and no kid ever had an incentive to go outside.

You did not sit next to strangers in lunchtime because you had a phone and can sit by yourself, you did not meat the woman of your dreams because you were to busy playing candy crush.
The starchild was never born because you did not inseminate the woman of your dreams.
